title: refactor(ci): update workflows + bump deps for Node 16 compatibility; streamline lint/test pipelines
author: Aisha Kumar
release_notes:
- Updated GitHub Actions workflows to consolidate lint/test jobs and reduce duplicated setup time.
- Bumped CI container/node images and JS deps for Node 16 LTS compatibility.
- Fixed flaky unit tests and added timeout guards for integration tests.
- No functional changes to runtime code; mostly infra and tooling improvements.
description:
Motivation: We observed increasing CI runtime and a set of failing workflows after upstream dependency churn and the Node 16 deprecation notices in some base images. This PR consolidates several Actions workflows, standardizes node/npm setup across jobs, upgrades a small set of devDependencies, and refactors lint/test job matrix to reduce redundant installations.

Scope and changes (summary):
- Consolidate .github/workflows/{lint.yml, test.yml, release.yml} into two workflows: ci.yml and release.yml with reusable workflow callers.
- Pin Node versions to 14/16 in the matrix and default to Node 16 for primary runners.
- Upgrade key devDependencies: eslint@8.x -> eslint@8.40.0, jest@29.x -> jest@29.7.0, typescript@4.9 -> typescript@5.1.6 (only in tooling, see breaking_change=false).
- Replace ad-hoc docker-based step with setup-node action and a cached npm-install step to speed up dependency install.
- Add job-level timeout and retry on flaky integration tests; add a lightweight smoke-test that runs on PRs to catch regressions early.
- Remove legacy workflow files and CI scripts: scripts/ci/setup-node-legacy.sh (deleted) and update README CI badge.

Checklist:
- [x] Consolidated workflows and ensured matrix covers supported node versions.
- [x] Bumped devDependencies and validated local build/test.
- [x] Added cache and speed improvements for npm installs.
- [x] Added integration test timeouts and retry logic.
- [x] Updated docs/README CI section and badges.

Commits (high-level):
- chore(ci): add reusable workflows and consolidate CI jobs
- chore(deps): bump eslint, jest, typescript for tooling
- fix(tests): stabilize flaky integration test with timeout and retry
- docs: update README CI badge and instructions

Files / Areas touched (high level):
- .github/workflows/ci.yml (new consolidated workflow)
- .github/workflows/release.yml (updated to call reusable workflow)
- package.json (devDependencies bumped)
- scripts/ci/* (removed legacy setup, added cache helper)
- test/integration/flaky-suite.test.ts (added retry/timeout guard)
- README.md (CI badge + small instructions)

Review conversation (summary):
- Ben Fletcher: Asked for justification on moving to Node 16 as default. Author replied: Node 16 is current LTS and reduces environment mismatch; matrix still tests Node 14. Added note in PR description.
- Diego Martinez: Requested that TypeScript bump be isolated to tooling so it doesn't affect build output; author confirmed only devDependencies were bumped and added a short smoke-run using tsc --noEmit in CI.
- Priya Narayanan: Flagged a flaky integration test that initially failed in CI run; author pushed a fix that adds a 10s retry/backoff and moved that test into a separate job with a longer timeout.
- CI bot: Initial run failed on a lint rule introduced by eslint upgrade (no-floating-promises). Author updated a couple of small files to satisfy rule and pushed.

CI status and iterations: 
- Run 1 (on PR open): ci.yml initial run --- failed (eslint errors + flaky integration test timeout).
- Run 2 (after fixes): ci.yml rerun --- partial pass (lint fixed, integration still flaky).
- Run 3 (after adding retry/timeout): ci.yml --- pass. Release workflow dry-run passed in subsequent run.

Testing and verification performed: 
- Local: yarn install, yarn lint, yarn test (unit), yarn test:integration (smoke).
- CI: full matrix for node 14/16 on Linux + macOS smoke on Node 16.
- Observed CI runtime decrease ~18% on average for PRs due to caching and consolidated steps.

Risk assessment and roll-out: 
- This PR is tooling-only; no runtime behavior changes expected. Dev dependency bumps limited to tooling and CI.
- Reverted workflows and pins retained for a week in case we need a rollback.

Merge: Squash-merged after approvals from Ben and Diego and CI green. Merged at 2026-02-18 with merge method: squash.

Notes for release engineers: Update repo-level CI docs and ensure org-level reusable workflow templates are aligned (I filed ENG-3421 to track follow-ups).
notes: This PR was intentionally authored as a focused infra change to reduce cognitive load during review. Follow-ups: convert more repos to use these reusable workflows and centralize caching behavior (ENG-3580).
